bullets: Nasdaq hit correction territory Thu Nov 5 on an AI-trade selloff; Dow Jones index plunged ~1,800 pts same day, then market bounced Fri-Mon.
Oil (Brent/WTI) fell through the week on cooling Mideast escalation risk and midterm-driven policy uncertainty, dragging energy names broadly.
10Y JGB and US Treasury yields eased as lower oil cooled inflation fears; futures flat-to-up Mon AM awaiting CPI and AI-sector earnings.
Nvidia fell ~3.4% after-hours Mon on a CEO security-probe headline, a reminder AI-megacap jitters remain the dominant macro swing factor.

ANF.why: Q3 was reportedly upbeat yet shares sank on market-gain days (Nov 3, -5.1% Nov 6); articles cite overvaluation vs GF Value, not a miss, cut, or downgrade. No dd.moves on file.
ANF.bull: No guidance cut, miss, or analyst downgrade found; sell-off reads as valuation/profit-taking after a big run.
ANF.bear: Repeated multi-day declines on up-market days suggest idiosyncratic selling pressure, not just rotation.
ANF.catalysts: none found; next earnings Nov 24 is outside the 7-day window
